_comment: REAL (paid) config template. Needs --allow-real. Key: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (haiku_direct) or RUNPOD_API_KEY (choice_endpoint) from the environment, or set env_file explicitly. For choice_endpoint also set choice_endpoint_id (or JUDGE_ADAPTER_CHOICE_ENDPOINT_ID) and choice_usd_per_second; choice_expected_model is optional.
